entries.title: A — INK & PARCHMENT
entries.style: Frame style A: hand-cut parchment edged by a confident expressive dark sepia ink contour. A finely drawn uneven inner keyline, tiny dry nib scratches and sparse crosshatching restricted to corners, subtle deckled fiber material within a disciplined silhouette. It should feel crafted by a meticulous eccentric field naturalist, like a treasured original pen-and-ink book illustration. Rich line quality, gentle irregularity, tiny controlled corner folds. No metal, no gems, no dangling objects, no decorative motifs outside the silhouette. Keep the large open face and clear frame profile. This is the most classic understated storybook option.
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: high-resolution game spell-card FRAME design selection board, original gothic survival storybook game aesthetic.
Create a beautifully crafted professional art-direction sheet, landscape 2048x1536 or higher if available. Crisp high-definition detailed ink drawing, editorial layout, warm dark charcoal background, generous spacing.
This is ONE coherent frame family shown at three use scales, NOT a finished card game UI.
Composition: large top row dominates 65% of the board, showing three FRONT-ON nearly square portrait card frames of equal outer 52:56 width:height proportion. Left BASIC, middle MODIFIER, right CONTROL. Lower left row shows all three simplified inventory versions designed to remain legible at a conceptual 64x64 size (no micro texture). Lower right row shows a single blank card and a short stack LYING FLAT on the ground, viewed from above, with a trapezoidal near edge wider than far edge, tiny thin paper layers stacking vertically. Ground cards must NOT stand up, NOT fan open.
CRITICAL SILHOUETTES shared across every style: BASIC is a rectangle with four subtly clipped 4px corners. MODIFIER is a six-sided vertically oriented hexagon with a single pointed peak top center and bottom center, straight vertical left and right sides; shoulders at 21% and 79% of height. CONTROL is the basic rectangle with a broad rectangular notch CUT OUT of its top middle: notch width 31% of card width, depth14% of height; the background must show through the notch. The center notch is a genuine missing section of the OUTER silhouette, not a plaque or an internal illustration. No shields, circles, octagons, arches, tall tarot proportions, or badges replacing these silhouettes.
All card faces have the SAME opaque PALE WARM GRAY parchment: top #E5DCC9, midpoint #DDD3BE, bottom #D4C7AD, very subtle top-to-bottom gradient. Never radial glow, never different colors for the three categories. Subtle paper fibers only visible on large collection versions. Edge outline dark brown #483729. Leave at least70% of the face clean open paper for future spell art. The card centers are BLANK: no illustrations, no fireballs, no letters, no printed descriptions, no title plates. Ornament belongs only to the frame rim, not a central magic circle.
Leave the lower-right corner quiet for a future small mechanism badge; do not draw an empty badge socket. Top-center stack count area must not gain a protruding crown or jewel. Collector detail must be exquisite yet restrained: refinements in linework and workmanship, not a very wide frame taking over the art space.
Inventory versions are separately simplified thick-lined 3–4-tone renderings of this SAME frame family, not miniatures of every large flourish. Ground is the same simplified style with real perspective and narrow front paper edges; use a small attached soft shadow only.
Labels outside the art only, clean restrained readable typography: the exact provided title, then "COLLECTION", "BASIC", "MODIFIER", "CONTROL", "INVENTORY", "GROUND". No other text, no numbers, no watermark, no logo.

It should feel crafted by a meticulous eccentric field naturalist, like a treasured original pen-and-ink book illustration. Rich line quality, gentle irregularity, tiny controlled corner folds. No metal, no gems, no dangling objects, no decorative motifs outside the silhouette. Keep the large open face and clear frame profile. This is the most classic understated storybook option.

entries.title: B — ANTIQUE BRASS
entries.style: Frame style B: elegant old spellbook page framed by an ink-brown binding and THIN matte aged-brass corner brackets with precise hand-engraved geometric scrollwork. Antique copper-gold tones are subdued, with tiny rubbed ivory highlights and faint patina, never shiny gold fantasy jewelry. Very fine engraved parallel strokes, restrained leaf-like engraving only within small corner brackets, thin connecting rule. The craftsmanship feels premium enough for a collectible album. The brackets follow each of the three exact silhouettes and leave the point/notch unmistakable. No giant crest, no gems, no protruding crown, no central emblem. Inventory reduces the metalwork to a few broad quiet corner accents.

entries.title: C — THORN ENGRAVING
entries.style: Frame style C: dark twisted thorn-vine engraving forming a narrow decorative rim, like an intricate antique woodcut inked on parchment. Controlled interlaced angular stems, sparse small sharp thorns, fine ivory incised strokes in the dark rim, subtly asymmetrical hand-cut character. Eerie but refined original gothic storybook design, not lush green nature magic. Keep vines entirely within the frame band; no giant roots, protruding spikes, skulls, faces, animals or dangling ornaments. The iconic rectangle/hexagon/notched silhouette remains crisp. Collection version has exquisite close-up woodcut linework; inventory retains only one bold simplified twisting contour and a few broad cuts. Keep a generous blank pale paper center.
